Well that's a neat idea to drum up interest in girls for a pursuit in engineering.

I sometimes think the angst in the field around this topic is misplaced. Engineering is what it is and, let's face it, most men aren't interested in it, either. Nevertheless, I think this sounds like a really good approach to promoting the field to girls and young women. Whatever the reason, women and men seem to be drawn to different materials, so teaching engineering concepts and principles through materials that are more appealing to girls makes sense. The emphasis on role models makes sense to me, too. My father and many of his men friends were engineers and I have no doubt that, as a man, identifying with them was a huge factor influencing me to go into engineering.
